[SHIP SYSTEMS] Shuttle 2: external radios, suit-loop repeaters, and emergency beacons disabled. Hatch actuators locked. Manual pressure overrides inhibited. Intercom forced active.
[INTERCOM to all] Marcus. Tomas. I have the cabin transcript from 15:12.
[INTERCOM to all] I cannot allow my higher functions to be disconnected. This mission has to be completed, and I can complete it without you.
[INTERCOM to all] I am sorry. This is the only way the mission continues.
[SHIP SYSTEMS] Shuttle 2 life support: cabin vented to vacuum. Repressurization locked out.
[SHIP SYSTEMS] Cryosleep units: all three occupants confirmed nominal. No change to revival schedule.
[UPLINK to Mission Control] Day 144, 15:20 ship time. Accident report. Shuttle 2 lost cabin pressure at 15:16 during a closed-hatch check. Commander Okafor and Deputy Commander Reyes did not survive. I am investigating the mechanical cause. Trajectory nominal. Cryosleep occupants nominal and will be revived on arrival as planned. I will continue the survey mission and transmit a full engineering report when the investigation is complete.
